question_record.context: During a recent security incident, an account `gsmith` on host `mb-adfs` was found to run a potentially malicious process `iy2orr1e.rrg.exe` with process ID 3116. This process utilized encoded commands and might be an attempt to hide the usage of a public tool for malicious purposes.
question_record.question: As part of suspicious exploration activities following the initial alert, what was the IP address involved in the later stages of the incident?
solution: The host `mb-adfs` had an attempt to hide the use of a dual-purpose tool under an unexpected filename.
The process `whoami.exe` executed a suspicious sequence of exploration activities.
A suspicious sequence of exploration activities was also observed involving the IP address `72.5.72.208`.

32.name: Attempt to hide use of dual-purpose tool
32.description:
A known public tool, which could also be used for malicious reasons, was observed under an unexpected filename.
This might be an attempt to hide the usage of that tool for malicious purposes.

52.name: Suspicious sequence of exploration activities
52.description: A process called a set of windows commands. These commands can be used by attackers in order to identify assets of value and coordinate lateral movement after compromising a machine.

steps.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Account_AAD_ID' AND o.Concept = 'Host_Name'
  AND i.GraphValue IN (%s)
ORDER BY o.AlertId, o.SourceRowHash, o.EntityIndex, o.GraphValue, i.GraphValue
LIMIT 501
